facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.get_image_files_partition: get a partitioned subset of image files for distributed feature extraction across workers
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.get_image_files_skip_done: get image files skipping those already processed by checking existing npy files in output folder
